div.div: Secrets live only in the hosts' environment settings: NEBIUS_API_KEY, the database connection, provider keys (TAVILY_API_KEY, CORE_API_KEY, OPENALEX_API_KEY). The browser receives only SUPABASE_URL and the publishable key; the Supabase redirect list must include the public URL. Nothing secret is in the repository.
